- [pudl.analysis](pudl/analysis/index.html.md): Modules providing programmatic analyses that make use of PUDL data.
- [pudl.analysis.allocate_gen_fuel](pudl/analysis/allocate_gen_fuel/index.html.md): Allocate data from core_eia923&#95;&#92;&#95;monthly_generation_fuel table to generator level.

- [pudl.analysis.ml_tools](pudl/analysis/ml_tools/index.html.md): Implements shared tooling for machine learning models in PUDL.

- [pudl.analysis.plant_parts_eia](pudl/analysis/plant_parts_eia/index.html.md): Aggregate plant parts to make an EIA master plant-part table.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/index.html.md): This module implements models for various forms of record linkage.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.classify_plants_ferc1](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/classify_plants_ferc1/index.html.md): Scikit-Learn classification pipeline for identifying related FERC 1 plant records.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.eia_ferc1_inputs](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/eia_ferc1_inputs/index.html.md): Prepare the inputs to the FERC1 to EIA record linkage model.

- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.eia_ferc1_record_linkage](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/eia_ferc1_record_linkage/index.html.md): Connect FERC1 plant tables to EIA’s plant-parts with record linkage.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.eia_ferc1_train](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/eia_ferc1_train/index.html.md): Create spreadsheets for manually mapping FERC-EIA records and validate matches.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.embed_dataframe](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/embed_dataframe/index.html.md): Tools for embedding a DataFrame to create feature matrix for models.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.link_cross_year](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/link_cross_year/index.html.md): Define a record linkage model interface and implement common functionality.
- [pudl.analysis.record_linkage.name_cleaner](pudl/analysis/record_linkage/name_cleaner/index.html.md): This module contains the implementation of CompanyNameCleaner class from OS-Climate’s financial-enti...
- [pudl.analysis.service_territory](pudl/analysis/service_territory/index.html.md): Compile historical utility and balancing area territories.

- [pudl.analysis.state_demand](pudl/analysis/state_demand/index.html.md): Estimate historical hourly state-level electricity demand.

- [pudl.transform.eia923](pudl/transform/eia923/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA923 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eia930](pudl/transform/eia930/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EIA930 data tables.
- [pudl.transform.eiaaeo](pudl/transform/eiaaeo/index.html.md): Transform raw AEO tables into normalized assets.
- [pudl.transform.eiaapi](pudl/transform/eiaapi/index.html.md): Clean and normalize EIA bulk electricity data.
- [pudl.transform.epacems](pudl/transform/epacems/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EPA CEMS data tables.
- [pudl.transform.epamats](pudl/transform/epamats/index.html.md): Module to perform data cleaning functions on EPA MATS data tables.
- [pudl.transform.ferc](pudl/transform/ferc/index.html.md): Module for shared helpers for FERC Form transforms.
- [pudl.transform.ferc1](pudl/transform/ferc1/index.html.md): Classes &amp; functions to process FERC Form 1 data before loading into the PUDL DB.
- [pudl.transform.ferc714](pudl/transform/ferc714/index.html.md): Transformation of the FERC Form 714 data.
- [pudl.transform.ferccid](pudl/transform/ferccid/index.html.md): Clean the FERC Company Identifier table.
- [pudl.transform.ferceqr](pudl/transform/ferceqr/index.html.md): Transform FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) data.
- [pudl.transform.gridpathratoolkit](pudl/transform/gridpathratoolkit/index.html.md): Transformations of the GridPath RA Toolkit renewable generation profiles.
- [pudl.transform.nrelatb](pudl/transform/nrelatb/index.html.md): Transform NREL ATB data into well normalized, cleaned tables.
- [pudl.transform.params](pudl/transform/params/index.html.md): A subpackage for defining data source-specific transformation parameters.
- [pudl.transform.params.ferc1](pudl/transform/params/ferc1/index.html.md): FERC 1 specific transformation parameters.
- [pudl.transform.phmsagas](pudl/transform/phmsagas/index.html.md): Classes &amp; functions to process PHMSA natural gas data before loading into the PUDL DB.
- [pudl.transform.rus](pudl/transform/rus/index.html.md): Code for transforming RUS data that pertains to more than one RUS Form.
- [pudl.transform.rus12](pudl/transform/rus12/index.html.md): Transform the RUS12 tables.
- [pudl.transform.rus7](pudl/transform/rus7/index.html.md): Transform the RUS7 tables.
- [pudl.transform.sec10k](pudl/transform/sec10k/index.html.md): Transformations and standardizations for SEC 10-K data tables.
- [pudl.transform.vcerare](pudl/transform/vcerare/index.html.md): Transformations of the Vibrant Clean Energy Resource Adequacy Renewable Energy (RARE) Power Dataset.
- [pudl.validate](pudl/validate/index.html.md): PUDL data validation tooling.
- [pudl.validate.dbt](pudl/validate/dbt/index.html.md): Wrap DBT invocations so we can get custom behavior.
- [pudl.validate.quality](pudl/validate/quality/index.html.md): Bespoke data quality checking utilities for PUDL data.
- [pudl.workspace](pudl/workspace/index.html.md): Tools for acquiring PUDL’s original input data and organizing it locally.
- [pudl.workspace.datastore](pudl/workspace/datastore/index.html.md): Datastore manages file retrieval for PUDL datasets.
- [pudl.workspace.resource_cache](pudl/workspace/resource_cache/index.html.md): Implementations of datastore resource caches.
- [pudl.workspace.setup](pudl/workspace/setup/index.html.md): Tools for setting up and managing PUDL workspaces.
